scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:headless
scripts.soak: npm run build:headless && node --jitless --max-semi-space-size=1 --no-lazy --optimize-for-size --expose-gc dist-headless/src/headless/soak.js --seed 7 --nights 10 --out soak.json
scripts.bench: npm run build && node scripts/bench.mjs --seed 42 --duration 30 --out bench.json
